change: GTK Dolby mapper 0.1.0+rogdv11: upload the enhancement layer only for an active NLQ and let libplacebo (patch 0003 of libplacebo-fel-system-dv) decide whether a Profile 7 master is reconstructed; the provider callback still maps Profile 7 only when it is, and names that decline.

build.environment: Throwaway container from the local GTK/WebKit SDK image, with libplacebo-rog387 1.0.0+private20261108-4 and librog-dv-provider387-1 1.0.0+private20261108-5+depfix2 (corrected shlibs), the provider SDK API 2 development package, libdovi-dev and FFmpeg headers added; -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror.
build.result: dpkg-buildpackage passed; the negotiation probe reported 169 checks, 0 failures, both for the first build against -3 and the final build against -4.
build.shlibs_note: libplacebo-rog387 -3 and the +depfix1 repacks shipped empty shlibs files, so the first build used a container-only override. The final build used the corrected -4 chain with no override: the core's libplacebo pin, libplacebo-rog387 (= 1.0.0+private20261108-4), comes from libplacebo's own shlibs, and the core ships its own shlibs (libgstgtkdovicore 0 libgstgtk-dovi-core0 (>= 0.1.0+rogdv11)).

qualification.method: Installed Showtime 50.0-2+rogdv5.15+depfix1 in the owner's unlocked desktop session (display in BT.2100 mode), 25 s per arm, mapper debug log at level 6. 'new' selects the first rogdv11 build (same mapper source, built against libplacebo -3 bytes, which -4 repacks unchanged) with LD_LIBRARY_PATH and GST_PLUGIN_PATH; 'stock' is the installed 0.1.0+rogdv10+depfix1. Inputs are 60 s video-only stream copies (DOVI configuration record preserved) made because the full MEL files do not start in Showtime (see limits). Pre-install arms: no package was installed at the time.

Metadata-only repacks with file contents identical to the installed packages: libplacebo-rog387 1.0.0+private20261108-4, librog-dv-provider387-1 1.0.0+private20261108-5+depfix2 and mpv 0.42.0-0ubuntu0+rogdv5.7+depfix2 (corrected shlibs, pinned to libplacebo -4; prepared by the session that owns the libplacebo MEL fix), and gstreamer1.0-gtk4 0.15.2-1ubuntu2+rogdv5.8+depfix2 and showtime 50.0-2+rogdv5.15+depfix2 (pins on core/plugin rogdv11 and, for Showtime, on the sink).

limits: Digital mapper decisions over 25 s windows, not pixels or light.

Both full MEL files fail to start in Showtime with stock and new mappers alike: each selects a PGS subtitle track by default, and playsink's subtitle overlay refuses the NVDEC CUDA-memory Dolby caps (not-negotiated) before the mapper sees a picture. The FEL title does not select its PGS track by default. That is a separate, pre-existing defect.
The qualification arms ran the first rogdv11 build; the post-install arms above exercise the final installed packages.
The owner's visual check of the picture is not part of this receipt.
